problems.title: Reduce The Maximum To Even K Times

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: repeat k times: find the maximum with a linear scan and halve it
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: a binary max-heap; k pops and pushes of the halved maximum, stopping early once the maximum is 0
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n + k log n) time/O(n) space
